title: A redaction category unknown to the boundary is refused at configuration time rather than silently ignored
asA: operator elicited into ADR-1603 with a mis-spelled additional category name
iWant: the factory to refuse the redaction category at configuration time with a message naming the offending value
soThat: a typo in an added category does not silently disable redaction for that field pattern

acceptanceCriteria.description: The factory's redaction configuration accepts kebab-cased or dotted-namespace category names (matching the ADR-1603 recommended-default shape) and refuses any other shape with a message naming the offending value and the accepted grammar.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an application configured with a redaction categories list including 'PII Email' (space, mixed case)
acceptanceCriteria.then: construction throws with a message naming 'PII Email' as the offending value
